name: Operation Iraqi Freedom
explanation: The 2006 Iraq deployment with Combined Joint Task Force Troy, about six months. The campaign phase recorded on the shadowbox is National Resolution. One of the two bronze stars on the Iraq Campaign Medal belongs to this phase.

name: Operation Iraqi Freedom
explanation: The 2009 Iraq deployment as an individual augmentee to the Army, about seven months. In theater: Task Force Iron Shield. Admin: 11th ADA. Customer: 332nd Air Expeditionary Wing at Joint Base Balad. The campaign phase recorded on the shadowbox is Iraq Sovereignty. This is the other bronze star on the Iraq Campaign Medal.

name: Operation Enduring Freedom
explanation: Afghanistan deployment of about seven months. Assigned to JCSE. In theater: CJSOTF-A. Customer: 3rd Special Forces Group, at FOB Delaram. One of the two bronze stars on the Afghanistan Campaign Medal.

name: Operation Enduring Freedom
explanation: A second Afghanistan deployment of about seven months, from Joint Communications Support Element. In theater: SOJTF-A. Partner: 290th JCSS. Customer: 75th Ranger Regiment, at FOB Orgun-E. The NATO Medal for ISAF is dated 2013 on the worksheet. This is the other Afghanistan campaign star.
